abstract: Round-2 revision of the manifest member identity design for issue 87, folding the round-1 adversarial design review REJECT of 3 Major, 5 Minor and 8 Notes. Committed at 3c31ed02330936458842d954666d7c3b88561567 on design/member-identity-87 over rev 1 at 9e18799, one file, plus 347 minus 60 lines, nothing pushed and no board file edited. All three Majors were adopted without appeal because all three were correct. The first is the one that matters most to the record - the probe underpinning the reopened dispatch-time path was FALSE as published, generalised from the tail of a file to the whole of it, and I re-derived it myself rather than accepting the reviewer's figures - the launch capture carries two runtime families, not one, and twenty Copilot payloads sat in the very file a probe row had declared unavailable. The conclusion survives and grows stronger, because the key the design depends on is populated across both families, so the wire is now specified per-family and the Copilot path turns out to need no convention at all. The second Major is the sentence check turned on the author - the design had traced its own Law 1 requirement to a JSON field and stopped one hop short of the string a human reads, so a new section now owns that hop, the view file and its two hundred and nine tests acquire named owners, and a wire required-set collision that would have blocked implementation is stated with its trade routed to the reviewer. The third is the author's own instrument firing correctly - an ordering rule had escaped into prose, and rather than delete it the revision pins it with a conformance vector specified to be red on arrival. Five Minors are folded, including two desk-provable facts pulled out of the probe list and answered by one scan, which closes an open question by measurement, and an argument the design owed against its own premise about vigilance, made with evidence drawn from the author's own log. Two self-caught defects are disclosed that no gate found - a citation to a verdict that does not exist on this branch, and a fault-injection restore that silently did not run.
